_meta.title: Thota Mitra Weather Conducive-Conditions & Spray Schedule Rules
_meta.status: HEURISTIC_TO_BE_VALIDATED, validate against farm records and CPCRI/UAS field trials

agronomic_distinction.published_cpcri_kau_guidance: CPCRI & KAU published qualitative disease factors (high humidity, cool temps, alternating rain/sun, 1% Bordeaux mixture on bunches pre-monsoon and every 40 days during rain breaks).
agronomic_distinction.software_numeric_heuristics: All numeric factor weights (35/30/20/15), humidity cut-offs (82%, 90%), 20-28°C temperature window, 4-hour dry requirement, and 20 km/h wind limits are heuristic thresholds engineered for software decision support, NOT official published numbers. Claim no clinical accuracy until validated.

authority_references: ICAR-Central Plantation Crops Research Institute (CPCRI) Koleroga Bulletin (Qualitative guidance)
Kerala Agricultural University (KAU) Package of Practices (Beverages & Stimulants)
Frontiers in Plant Science (Timing of fungicide application against fruit rot)
Deccan Herald Malnad & Coastal Plantation reports
University of Agricultural and Horticultural Sciences (UAHS / KSNUAHS) Shivamogga
_meta.disclaimer: Decision support only, not an agricultural guarantee. Always verify with local CPCRI/UAS advisories and field conditions.

schedule_engine.outbreak_monitoring_window: Monitor closely 40–50 days after first monsoon rain in patchy-rain seasons; this is a documented timing observation, not a disease prediction.

stages.target_window: Late May to 1st week of June (before continuous monsoon rains start)
stages.purpose: Shield young tender nut bunches with 1% Bordeaux mixture before Phytophthora meadii inoculum spreads.
stages.fungicide: 1% Bordeaux mixture (1kg CuSO4 + 1kg CaO in 100L water) with rosin/adhesive

stages.target_window: Around 40 days after 1st spray (typically mid-July during a rain break)
stages.purpose: Renew copper barrier washed off by heavy South-West monsoon rains.

stages.target_window: August / September if monsoon rains persist
stages.purpose: Protect developing nuts from late-season fruit rot / mahali drops.

spray_guidelines.recommended_treatment: 1% Bordeaux mixture on nut bunches with rosin adhesive or Metalaxyl-Mancozeb 0.2%
1% Bordeaux mixture crown spray or Bordeaux paste applied to central bud

low.action_summary_en: Weather is currently dry or sunny. Environmental conditions are not conducive for fungal spread.
low.action_summary_kn: ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಹವಾಮಾನ ಒಣ ಅಥವಾ ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದೆ. ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರ ಹರಡುವಿಕೆಗೆ ಅನುಕೂಲಕರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.

medium.action_summary_en: Moderate humidity and intermittent wetness. Fungus can sporulate; keep sprayers and fungicide ready.
medium.action_summary_kn: ಮಧ್ಯಮ ತೇವಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಆಗಾಗ ಮಳೆ. ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯ; ಔಷಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಪ್ರೇಯರ್ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿರಲಿ.

high.action_summary_en: Highly favorable weather for Koleroga (cool temps, >90% RH, continuous rain). Spray immediately at the next rain break.
high.action_summary_kn: ಕೊಳೆರೋಗ ಹರಡುವಿಕೆಗೆ ಹವಾಮಾನ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಅನುಕೂಲಕರವಾಗಿದೆ (ತಂಪು ಹವೆ, ಅಧಿಕ ತೇವಾಂಶ, ಸತತ ಮಳೆ). ಮಳೆ ಬಿಡುವು ಕೊಟ್ಟ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ.

reasons.heavy_rain: Heavy rain forecast will wash away Bordeaux mixture before 4-hour drying time.
reasons.high_rain_prob: High probability of rain within the critical drying window.
reasons.high_wind: Wind speeds exceed 20 km/h; canopy spraying will cause severe drift and uneven coverage.

reasons.optimal_conditions: Clear break with low rain probability and calm winds. Excellent 4+ hour drying window.

reasons.intermittent_weather: Marginal weather or scattered showers. Check morning sky and spray only if clear 4-hour break occurs.
